items.description:
Giovanni's Deliworld is a Cape Town delicatessen in Green Point, serving Italian deli produce, coffee, fine wine and grocery items. It opened on 1 June 1989 as a small deli offering fresh meals, local breads, cheeses and charcuterie, and later added a coffee bar that brought a European feel to the space.

The business is known for its sandwiches, ready-made meals and cappuccinos, and it also offers catering. Its own site describes it as the destination for Italian deli, coffee, fine wine and grocery shopping in the heart of Green Point. It suits anyone looking for ready-to-eat meals, Italian groceries or a good coffee on Main Road.

items.description:
Hello Indigo Halo is a crystal and gift shop at The Old Biscuit Mill in Woodstock, Cape Town. It describes itself as a unique space filled with fantasy, crystals, jewellery and distinctive gifts. The shop stocks raw and polished crystals, incense, statues, tarot cards and other esoteric supplies.

The store is designed for sensory exploration, with a curated mix of crystals and small finds for quiet moments and browsing. An online store with worldwide delivery extends the range beyond the shop floor. It suits visitors to the Old Biscuit Mill who are looking for crystals, gifts and something a little different.

items.description:
JAM Clothing is a family clothing store at Golden Acre Shopping Centre in Cape Town's CBD, with ladies, mens, girls and boys ranges. The brand positions itself as famous for less, with budget-friendly kids' fashion across a range of brands and in-store promotions.

The store's own page lists the Golden Acre shop and its opening hours, and it gives the store's direct contact line for enquiries. The JAM group also runs a JAM Cares programme, which it promotes on its website. The store suits parents and families who want affordable everyday clothing close to the city centre. The shop is at Shop S25 in Golden Acre, between Strand Street and Adderley Street.

items.description:
Jawitz Properties Pinelands is a branch of the Jawitz estate agency at Central Square in Pinelands, Cape Town. The branch has operated in Pinelands, Thornton and Maitland for about 12 years, and its profile lists residential sales, estates and new developments alongside rentals.

The branch says it listens closely to clients to understand their property needs, and it stresses professional service and ethical standards. Its profile features area guides, bond calculators and the latest listings to rent. It suits buyers, sellers and tenants in Pinelands and the surrounding area. The branch is at Shop 6, Central Buildings in Central Square, so buyers and tenants can visit in person.

items.description:
Kelfords Ford & Mazda is an independent Ford franchise dealership at 11 Victoria Street in Somerset West, selling new and used vehicles. Its Ford-accredited service centre and parts department handle servicing and repairs, using genuine Ford parts and expert technicians. The dealership also sells tyres from top brands and accessories such as roll bars, tow bars and load-box covers.

Customers can book a Ford service online by filling in a booking sheet, and the dealership confirms each booking by email, SMS or phone. Its fitment and detailing centre fits Llumar window film that reduces UV and heat and helps guard against smash-and-grab attacks. Full valets, nano protection and paint protection are also offered. The dealership suits Ford owners in Somerset West who want service, parts and vehicle protection in one place.

items.description:
Mantra Cafe is a cafe by the sea in Camps Bay, Cape Town, upstairs at 43 Victoria Road. It has been open since 2016 and describes itself as a grand cafe by the sea. The cafe serves walk-in breakfast, and lunch and dinner from an a la carte menu, with a room that looks out across the Atlantic.

The cafe also hosts art exhibitions, and it currently shows a series of new and recent works by a local artist. Guests can book a table through its website. It suits a relaxed breakfast or a sea-view meal in Camps Bay. The room is upstairs, so the view across the bay is part of the experience of eating there.

Noluthando Educare Centre is an early childhood day care centre founded in 2010. It began as a small group of passionate educators and has grown into a community hub. The centre's approach is play-based learning, which it says has shaped how children are nurtured as it has evolved.

The centre describes its environment as nurturing and inclusive, with values designed to help every child feel valued and supported in their learning. It celebrates diversity and engages families and the wider community, which it sees as essential to children's development. It suits parents in Imizamo Yethu who want an early learning centre that puts play and inclusion first.

items.description:
Old Khaki is a casual lifestyle clothing store at the V&A Waterfront, on the Upper Level of Victoria Wharf Shopping Centre. It sells relaxed clothing and accessories for men and women, from everyday essentials to durable outdoor pieces, in a casual South African style.

The Waterfront's store listing shows a rating of 4.4 from 25 Google reviews and gives the store's contact details. The brand's clothing is designed for people who value relaxed, easygoing living. It suits shoppers who want casual wardrobe staples, and visitors exploring the Waterfront who want to pick up something practical. The store is on the Upper Level of Victoria Wharf, in Shops 7245 and 7246.

items.description:
Paradise Road is a bakery cafe inside Cardiff Castle at 58 Main Street in Newlands, Cape Town. Its counter offers fresh patisserie, croissants and French pastries, with daily salads and sandwiches available in store. The cafe also bakes fresh bread and serves coffee, with breakfast and light lunches on the menu.

The business sells a pantry range online for collection in store, so customers can order ahead and pick up from the cafe. Cardiff Castle, where the cafe sits, is the historic heart of Newlands Village and is home to restaurants and artisanal delis. Paradise Road suits a morning coffee, a breakfast or a light lunch in Newlands.

items.description:
Petrie's Pharmacy is a family pharmacy at 13 Regent Road in Sea Point, Cape Town, founded in the early 1940s. The practice was taken over in 1992 together with long-standing staff, and it describes its service as friendly, caring and helpful in a retail pharmacy setting.

The pharmacy dispenses prescriptions and offers chronic medication management and personalised health advice. It also runs a delivery service, offers complimentary medicine and holds free health screenings, including blood pressure checks. It suits residents of Sea Point who want a community pharmacy close to home. Its listing and site both give the Regent Road address, and customers can contact the pharmacy by phone or through its contact form for questions about prescriptions and health advice.

Pho & Bun Vietnamese Kitchen is a halaal Vietnamese restaurant in Diep River, Cape Town, and is Muslim-owned. The menu covers Asian Vietnamese dishes, with light meals, lunch and dinner service, takeaways and delivery.

Guests can use the car park, pay by credit card and rely on waiter service, and the restaurant is wheelchair accessible. Its listing gives a medium price range of about R100 to R300 per person, which makes it a casual option for families and groups. It suits diners who want Vietnamese food prepared to halaal standards in the Diep River area. Guests can eat in or take their meal home, and the restaurant also takes orders for delivery.

items.description:
Shakespeare's is a restaurant in Heritage Square on Vrede Street in Durbanville, Cape Town, with a theatrical theme. It is a re-imagining of a 50-year-old Durbanville establishment, and it serves breakfast, lunch, dinner and high tea. The concept is fine food, good wine and entertainment for grown-ups.

The interior uses old furnishings and crockery brought in from around the country, and the restaurant displays a 404-year-old bible and a 90-year-old baby grand piano. The menu follows the theme, with a main dish named after a quote from The Merchant of Venice and a dessert named after Hamlet. Nightly performances are part of the evening. It suits diners who want an evening out with food and theatre.
